reason: The public WFS DescribeFeatureType exposes only station-summary fields (station number/name/owner, geometry, first and latest survey dates, link). It does not expose the transect, measurement-point, species, or quantitative-cover fields required to freeze the Tampa early-warning endpoint before biological row access.
interpretation: NOVANA remains scientifically promising and publicly documented as containing time, transect, measurement point, species and cover, but the currently accessible response-independent WFS schema is only a station catalogue. v1 therefore stops rather than infer measurement schema from biological rows.
next_rule: Any future NOVANA attempt must be separately versioned and must obtain a response-independent measurement-schema contract (for example official API/OpenAPI/data-dictionary metadata) before GetFeature or CSV row access.
